research.name: AnimXYZ
research.note: CSS animation library where words in an xyz attribute, such as fade up big, compose one shared keyframe through CSS variables.

effects: animations composed from utility words in an xyz attribute (xyz="fade up big")
single shared @keyframes driven by --xyz-* CSS variables instead of per-animation keyframes
staggered letter-by-letter entrance where each letter combines different fade, rotate, flip and scale utilities
